high.title: Danantara CEO Responds to IHSG Plunge After State-Owned Export Company Formation
high.summary: Indonesia's main stock index (IHSG) fell 3.54% to 6,094 points following the formation of PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia, a state-owned company to manage strategic commodity exports including palm oil, coal, and ferro alloy. The market dropped over 2% during President Prabowo's initial announcement of the new export governance policy.

high.title: IHSG Plunges Nearly Below 6,000 Level
high.summary: Indonesia's composite stock index (IHSG) closed down 3.54% at 6,094 points, nearly falling below the critical 6,000 level. The sharp decline reflects market concerns over new export policies and regulatory changes affecting major Indonesian commodities.

high.title: Airlangga to Brief Investors After IHSG Collapse
high.summary: Economic Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto will provide detailed explanations to investors about the new state-owned export company policy following market turbulence. The government aims to ensure all business players have complete information before the June 1 transition to PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia.

high.title: Massive Gas Reserves Discovered in Kutai
high.summary: Indonesia's Ministry of Energy discovered massive gas reserves in Kutai Basin, East Kalimantan, with Geliga-1 well holding potential gas resources of 5 TCF and 300 million barrels of oil equivalent condensate. Total potential production reaches 7 TCF gas and 375 million barrel oil equivalent condensate, significantly boosting Indonesia's energy reserves.

high.title: Djarum Group's SUPR Plans Delisting, Offers Rp 45,000 Per Share
high.summary: Major conglomerate Djarum Group's PT Solusi Tunas Pratama Tbk (SUPR) plans to delist from Indonesia Stock Exchange and go private. The company is offering Rp 45,000 per share as part of its strategic business evaluation for more efficient asset and operational management.

high.title: Luhut Apologizes to Global Investors
high.summary: National Economic Council Chairman Luhut Binsar Pandjaitan apologized to global investors and investment managers in Singapore regarding Indonesia's volatile financial market conditions due to geopolitical sentiment and oil price increases. He acknowledged potential negative impacts on investors from the current domestic situation.

medium.title: Government Claims Positive Business Response to DSI Export State Company
medium.summary: Economic Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto claims businesses responded positively to the formation of Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia (DSI) export state company. The policy aims to maintain competitive prices for Indonesian natural resource commodities and strengthen Indonesia's leverage in commodity trading.

medium.title: Coal Entrepreneurs Still Questioning Export Rules Through State Company
medium.summary: Indonesian Coal Mining Association (APBI) awaits technical details on natural resource export regulations through state company Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia (DSI). Many policy details remain unclear, with further meetings scheduled with Deputy Energy Minister to discuss contract status, traders, and system implementation.

medium.title: Airlangga Reveals Reasons for Creating Export State Company to Entrepreneurs
medium.summary: Economic Coordinating Minister explains the government formed a specialized state company for strategic natural resource commodity exports due to discrepancies in export-import data with trading partner countries. The move aims to strengthen export oversight and reduce misinvoicing risks in trade transactions.

medium.title: OJK Admits Indonesia's Carbon Trading Transactions Small Compared to Europe and China
medium.summary: Financial Services Authority (OJK) acknowledges Indonesia's carbon trading (IDXCarbon) transactions remain small at Rp 93.7 billion compared to EU's $700 billion and China's $10-40 billion. The disparity highlights the need for improved market liquidity and development of Indonesia's carbon trading infrastructure.

medium.title: Indonesia to Export 500,000 Tons of Fertilizer to Australia Worth Rp 7 Trillion
medium.summary: Agriculture Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman announced Indonesia will export urea fertilizer to Australia worth Rp 7 trillion. The shipment will be conducted in stages, representing a significant export opportunity for Indonesia's fertilizer industry and strengthening bilateral trade relations with Australia.

medium.title: Finance Minister Cancels Hajj Pilgrimage
medium.summary: Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa canceled his planned hajj pilgrimage scheduled for May 21, 2026, instead attending a lunch invitation from President Prabowo Subianto at the Presidential Palace. His presence at the palace suggests ongoing important economic discussions during this critical policy transition period.
